sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx focal plane array, 384x288, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 35 mK; optical: 1/2.8in progressive scan CMOS, 4 MP
features: bi-spectrum thermal + optical mini positioning system (PTZ)
thermal module: 384x288 VOx uncooled, 17 um pixel pitch, NETD <= 35 mK, 8-14 um
thermal lens 15 mm F1.0 (min. focusing distance 0.5 m)
optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 4.8-153 mm 32x motorized zoom lens
thermographic temperature measurement -20 to 550 C, accuracy max(+/- 2 C, +/- 2%)
dynamic fire and smoke detection (up to 10 fire + 10 smoke points)
deep-learning VCA: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exit
PTZ: pan 360 continuous, tilt -90 to +90, 300 presets
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD5537T-15 is a bi-spectrum thermal (384x288) and 4 MP optical mini positioning system with a built-in GPU for deep-learning VCA, thermographic temperature measurement (-20 to 550 C) and fire/smoke detection, aimed at fire prevention in substations, gas stations and factories. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 and thermal is Channel 2, exposed as separate streams. PTZ via ONVIF.
